title: Well-Conditioned Oblivious Perturbations in Linear Space
abstract: arXiv:2604.23193v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Perturbing a deterministic $n$-dimensional matrix with small Gaussian noise is a cornerstone of smoothed analysis of algorithms [Spielman and Teng, JACM 2004], as it reduces the condition number of the input to $O(n)$, and with it the complexity of many matrix algorithms. However, when deployed algorithmically, these perturbations are expensive due to the cost of generating and storing $n^2$ Gaussian random variables. We propose a perturbation that requires generating and storing $O(n)$ random numbers in $O(\log n)$ bits of precision, and reduces the condition number of any deterministic matrix to $O(n)$, matching Gaussian perturbations. Our result takes a step towards derandomizing matrix perturbations in numerical linear algebra, and in particular, implies that we can solve an $n\times n$ linear system to within $\varepsilon$ backward error in $O(n^2\log(n)/\varepsilon)$ time using only $O(n\log n)$ random bits. translated_title: 线性空间中具有良好条件数的无关扰动
translated_abstract: 用小的高斯噪声扰动确定性的 n 维矩阵是算法平滑分析 [Spielman and Teng, JACM 2004] 的基石，因为它能将输入的条件数降低到 O(n)，从而随之降低许多矩阵算法的复杂度。然而，在实际算法部署中，这类扰动由于需要生成和存储 n² 个高斯随机变量而代价高昂。我们提出了一种只需生成和存储 O(n) 个、精度为 O(log n) 比特的随机数的扰动方法，它能将任意确定性矩阵的条件数降低到 O(n)，与高斯扰动的效果相当。我们的结果朝着数值线性代数中矩阵扰动的去随机化迈进了一步；特别地，它意味着我们可以仅使用 O(n log n) 个随机比特，在 O(n²log(n)/ε) 时间内将 n×n 线性方程组求解至 ε 的后向误差。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种仅需 O(n) 个 O(log n) 比特随机数的无关扰动方法，能将任意确定性矩阵的条件数降至 O(n)（效果与高斯扰动相当），从而仅需 O(n log n) 个随机比特即可在 O(n²log(n)/ε) 时间内求解 n×n 线性方程组至 ε 后向误差，推动了矩阵扰动的去随机化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an oblivious perturbation requiring only O(n) random numbers of O(log n) bits that reduces any deterministic matrix's condition number to O(n)—matching Gaussian perturbations—enabling n×n linear systems to be solved to ε backward error in O(n²log(n)/ε) time with only O(n log n) random bits, a step toward derandomizing matrix perturbations in numerical linear algebra.
